svg.title: Low white count: confirm neutropenia and grade it by the absolute neutrophil count, then split on fever. Febrile neutropenia is an emergency worked up and treated in order; without fever, sort the acquired and congenital causes and know the infection risk

svg.text: Low WBC (< 4 × 10⁹/L): is it NEUTROPENIA, how SEVERE, and is there FEVER?

svg.text: neutropenia = absolute neutrophil count (ANC) < 1.5 × 10⁹/L: the usual cause
